annotations.title: Route a number to an agent

description:
Set the saved agents that answer a number's calls and texts.

        Replaces the selected routing settings. Registering or unregistering inbound
        voice can change carrier and LiveKit routing; text-only changes leave it unchanged.
        Clearing the voice route stops AI call answers; clearing the text route stops
        agent replies to texts. Restoring a route does not recover missed interactions.
        Omitted settings retain their current values.
        Returns the updated number record or an error.

clear_sms.description: ``true`` removes the agent that answers texts.
clear_sms.title: Clear Sms

clear_voice.description: ``true`` removes the agent that answers calls.
clear_voice.title: Clear Voice

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_id.description: Workspace phone number ID, from ``list_numbers`` or ``acquire_number``.
number_id.title: Number Id

sms_agent_id.description: Agent that answers incoming texts, from ``list_agents`` or ``create_agent``.
sms_agent_id.title: Sms Agent Id

voice_agent_id.description: Agent that answers incoming calls, from ``list_agents`` or ``create_agent``.
voice_agent_id.title: Voice Agent Id

name: route_number

capabilities.description: Channels this number supports, e.g. ['voice'], ['sms'], or both.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country code this number belongs to.
country_code.title: Country Code

inbound_registered.description: True while the number is attached for inbound calls at the carrier and on Hail's LiveKit inbound trunk. Set when voice_agent_id is set.
inbound_registered.title: Inbound Registered

is_dedicated.description: True if this number is owned by the organization. False for shared-pool numbers.
is_dedicated.title: Is Dedicated

sms_agent_id.description: Agent that answers texts to this number. Null: texts only reach your webhooks.
sms_agent_id.title: Sms Agent Id

subject_name.description: Name of the person or company the verification used to buy this number is for. Null when no verification was used or the name is unknown.
subject_name.title: Subject Name

subject_type.description: Who the verification used to buy this number is for: 'person' or 'business'. Null when no verification was used.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

verification_id.description: Hail id of the verification used to buy this number. Null when no verification was used.
verification_id.title: Verification Id

voice_agent_id.description: Agent that answers calls to this number. Null: calls ring out.
voice_agent_id.title: Voice Agent Id

title: Route a number to an agent
